```python
def generate_palindrome(n):
    # Generate a basic palindrome structure
    base = "Able was I ere I saw Elba."
    repeated_base = base * ((n // len(base)) + 1)
    return repeated_base[:n]

# Generate a 255-character palindrome
palindrome_255 = generate_palindrome(255)
print(palindrome_255)
```
